h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Baranagar

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Baranagar

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Baranagar

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Baranagar to ward parks, housing societies, schools and community grounds along the northern edge of Kolkata. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away. We send them by road and install them through our team or a dealer covering eastern India.

Neighbourhood parks in Baranagar are used most by older residents, many of whom walk every morning and meet friends there in the evening. An open gym here should start with them in mind. Choose machines that are easy to get on and off, with seats at a comfortable height and handles that give a firm grip. Keep the machines on level ground close to the path, not across a lawn that turns muddy in the monsoon. The climate is hot and humid with heavy rain from June to September, so galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are the right choice.

richText.heading: Machines older residents use every day

c: For a ward park with many senior users, gentle machines matter more than strength stations. The
gives seated cardio with a backrest. The

combines shoulder wheels with a waist twist, and two or three people can use it together. Both use body weight only, so the user sets the pace. Put a bench nearby, since older users like to rest between machines.

facts.value: About 1,650 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines are easiest for senior citizens?
items.a: Seated and low-impact machines: the Fun Cycle, seated twisters, Tai Chi wheels and the Fun Walker. They need no adjustment and let each person move at their own pace.

items.q: Can a ward committee in Baranagar order a few machines?
items.a: Yes. Many parks start with three or four. Send us the park size and photos, and we will send a layout drawing and quote.

items.q: Do you supply benches as well?
items.a: Yes. Our Garden Decor range includes benches, gazebos and pergolas. A bench beside the open gym gives older users a place to rest between machines.
